watchtower_identity_clarification.finding: Watchtower is NOT a single canonical operation row with one fixed operation_id. It is an identity CLASS: operator_identity='WATCHTOWER', identity_confidence='LINEAGE_CONFIRMED', spanning MANY rows in the live wt_operations table (each with its own AUTOINCREMENT INTEGER operation_id and a human-readable name WATCHTOWER_HUB_<prefix>).
watchtower_identity_clarification.evidence_source: src/analysis/watchtower_operations_bridge.py module docstring and _launch_creators() implementation; src/core/watchtower_init.py schema (wt_operations.operation_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT)
watchtower_identity_clarification.implication: There is no single 'the Watchtower operation_id' this artifact can name from repository evidence without a live production DB read, which P3 authority forbids. This assertion therefore protects the ENTIRE identity class, not one row, and does not claim to have enumerated the current member set.

current_state_read_attempt.reason: production_database_read = false for P3; wt_operations lives only in the live database/wt_ops_v2.db (4.0GB, last modified 2026-08-18T16:24:00+01:00). No static/frozen export of current Watchtower operation_id set, member set, or status exists elsewhere in the repository.

evidence: src/acquisition/b2n_qualification.py has zero import of, or reference to, wt_operations, watchtower_operations_bridge, operation_store_v2, or any db_connect/database module.

src/analysis/watchtower_operations_bridge.py (the module that WRITES operator_identity='WATCHTOWER' rows) makes zero RPC calls and is not imported by, called from, or in any way reachable from b2n_qualification.py or its executor/test suite.
B2N's only local output surface is its own append-only JSONL attempt ledger (B2NAttemptLedger), which has no code path capable of writing to database/wt_ops_v2.db or any wt_operations-adjacent table.
protection_mechanism.conclusion: B2N, as implemented, cannot reach the Watchtower identity class or any specific WATCHTOWER_HUB_<prefix> operation row through any code path. This is a structural (not merely policy) guarantee for the current implementation.

candidate_association_rule.rule: If a future B2N run (or any downstream consumer of B2N's candidate evidence) produces evidence that appears connected to a Watchtower-identified creator, mint, or funding corridor, that output MUST be represented as a candidate association only (e.g. candidate_evidence, candidate_relationship, candidate_operational_family_relationship) and MUST NOT automatically create, modify, or extend any wt_operations row, wt_operation_members row, or operator_identity='WATCHTOWER' classification.
